provenance.what: shell-HTTP refusals while verifying the relay mobile-access provider; used as regressions
redacted: a live bearer token used for the local API handshake
the operator's public hostname, which appeared inside a JSON request body
provenance.note: command SHAPES are verbatim. The token and the hostname are not, and the literal replacement table lives only in the generating script, which is not kept.

refusals.verdict: a REMOTE curl to the relay public hostname - a true positive
refusals.command: echo "=== cloudflared-tunnel config ==="; docker inspect cloudflared-tunnel --format '{{.HostConfig.NetworkMode}}' 2>/dev/null; docker inspect cloudflared-tunnel --format '{{json .Config.Cmd}}' 2>/dev/null; docker inspect cloudflared-tunnel --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "TUNNEL|TOKEN" | sed 's/=.\{8\}.*/=<redacted>/' | head -3; echo; echo "=== is dsh1.example.com reachable right now? ==="; timeout 15 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "dsh1.example.com -> %{http_code}\n" https://dsh1.example.com/relay/health 2>&1 || echo "  (unreachable/timeout)"; echo; echo "=== DNS ==="; timeout 10 dig +short dsh1.example.com 2>/dev/null | head -3 || getent hosts dsh1.example.com 2>/dev/null || echo "  (no resolve)"

refusals.verdict: the target was $B = http://127.0.0.1:3080/... ; the body URL is data
refusals.command:
TOKEN=REDACTED-TOKEN; rm -f /tmp/j; curl -s -L -o /dev/null -c /tmp/j -b /tmp/j "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=$TOKEN"; A=(-b /tmp/j -H "origin: http://127.0.0.1:3080" -H 'content-type: application/json'); B=http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/mobile-access
echo "=== 1. select origin provider ==="
curl -s -m 10 "${A[@]}" -X POST -d '{"provider":"origin"}' $B/remote/provider -o /tmp/p.json -w "  http=%{http_code}\n"
echo "=== 2. save origin config for dsh2 ==="
curl -s -m 12 "${A[@]}" -X POST -d '{"version":1,"publicOrigin":"https://dsh2.example.com","listenHost":"127.0.0.1","listenPort":3444,"allowedCidrs":["127.0.0.0/8"]}' $B/remote/origin/configure -o /tmp/oc.json -w "  http=%{http_code}\n"
node -e 'const o=require("/tmp/oc.json");if(o.error)console.log("  ERR:",JSON.stringify(o.error).slice(0,300));else console.log("  configured:",JSON.stringify(o).slice(0,200))'
echo "=== 3. start it ==="
curl -s -m 12 "${A[@]}" -X POST -d '{"running":true}' $B/remote/control -o /tmp/s.json -w "  http=%{http_code}\n"
node -e 'const o=require("/tmp/s.json");console.log("  provider:",o.provider,"running:",o.running,"state:",o.state);console.log("  origin:",JSON.stringify(o.providers?.origin||{}).slice(0,220))'
sleep 5
echo "=== listeners ==="; ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':3444|:3443'

refusals.verdict: the target was the same local $B ; the body URL is data
refusals.command: curl -s -m 12 -b /tmp/j -H "origin: http://127.0.0.1:3080" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST -d '{"version":1,"publicOrigin":"https://dsh2.example.com","listenHost":"127.0.0.1","listenPort":3444,"allowedCidrs":["127.0.0.0/8"]}' http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/mobile-access/remote/origin/configure -o /tmp/oc.json -w "origin configure http=%{http_code}\n"; node -e 'const o=require("/tmp/oc.json");if(o.error)console.log("  ERR:",JSON.stringify(o.error).slice(0,300));else console.log("  ok:",JSON.stringify(o).slice(0,240))' 2>/dev/null || head -c 240 /tmp/oc.json
